reviewer_note: Run directories read only; no model script executed. Kraken-cad venv for OCP booleans, physics venv for trimesh ray casts.

collisions.method: Direct OpenCascade BRepAlgoAPI_Common on fix1 STEP exports at assembly.json transforms; volumes in mm3.

sightlines.method:
Label sightlines on the assembled fix1 STL meshes (trimesh, rtree ray-triangle).
For every label, ~600 area-weighted glyph points (from labels.json, placed 0.02 mm in front of the
label's open face) are cast toward an orthographic viewer in front of the grid (-Y) at
0/30/45/60/75/85 deg elevation. A point counts as visible when its ray hits nothing. The first
surface hit is attributed to a part ('own' = the label's bin, e.g. its stacking lip or front wall).
Fill: inner back-wall points below the flat fill top from capacity.json are counted as covered.
Residual wall: rays from just inside each pocket floor, away from the viewer, measure material left
between the glyph floor and the outer surface. Stack scenarios add one extra 2u bin at the
documented 13.65 mm offset on a host and re-test every label.

capacity.method:
Capacity and fill height per compartment from actual STEP void (direct OCP Common).
Same nominal hardware volumes and 0.6 packing fraction as reviews/kimi-gridfinity/capacity.py;
adds the flat fill height at the target count and at half the target, used to test whether the
contents cover the inner back-wall labels. Packing fraction is an assumption, not a pour test.

printability.method:
Printability census on the fix1 STL exports in their supplied print pose (assembly rotation 0,
bin bottom on z=0), compared with the original one-shot exports: binary STL header check,
watertightness, connected bodies, downward-facing area steeper than 45 deg from vertical above the
bed (support candidates; small bridged ceilings included), and part count vs exports.
